refactoringWorkflow.description: Step-by-step process for safe DefName refactoring
steps: 1. Identify target DefName and check if it exists in this map
2. Check crossReferences to find all Defs that reference the target
3. Check resourceMappings to find external files that need updating
4. Check translation files in Languages/ folder
6. Update resource file paths if needed

criticalDefs.description: Defs that are referenced by many others - changes require careful review

complexDefs.description: Defs with many dependencies - changes may have wide impact
